claim: P1 engineering qualification of the ordinary CPU Graph default against same-implementation direct fused cost, natural oneDNN sequence and complete Native graph, on caller-thread serial and the same persistent two-worker Sched executor; 5% practical margin. The external caller reserves one physical P core and the two actual workers reserve two other P cores (three cores total); the shared executor uses the existing low-latency idle policy on both arms.

configuration.delivery_shape: static library built from the pinned clean oneDNN source checkout
configuration.algorithm: two experimental x64 float32 BRGEMM ukernel plans plus HYLE SIMD separate-input SwiGLU
configuration.routes: direct fused region boundary and natural four-operation sequence are separate workload peers

configuration.role: Explicit Native implementation from the 1a3a8d0e immutable product projection; all compiled Native product files remain identical in the new benchmark candidate.
configuration.threads: caller-thread serial or the same two-worker executor; external caller and workers reserve three distinct physical P cores, low-latency idle policy on both arms
configuration.semantic_delta: same f32 inputs, constant weights, numerical tolerance, outputs and terminal completion

ownership_topology.candidate: One immutable HYLE Graph Executable retains the exact four-node oneDNN/SIMD region artifact; one exclusive pre-bound Invocation owns its aligned workspace, maps four caller-owned read-only boundaries and one caller-owned output, submits two synchronous executor episodes and observes one terminal Completion
ownership_topology.peer: The same process retains independently created copies of the identical two oneDNN BRGEMM plans and HYLE SIMD activation route; caller-owned aligned intermediate and scratch Buffers are fixed before measurement, and each episode maps the same four read-only boundaries plus one output
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both routes execute the identical gate/up pair, in-place HYLE SIMD SwiGLU and down BRGEMM over separately but identically initialized storage; setup, JIT, allocation and binding are excluded, while Graph bookkeeping and both routes' normal storage/completion boundaries are charged
